incident.description: INC1_CELL_A on eniq_oss_1 reports accessibility at 63% on 2026-06-29. Two CM changes were applied on 2026-06-27: CELLBARRED toggled to 1 and DLCHANNELBANDWIDTH reduced from 20000 to 5000. An unrelated Backhaul alarm was raised for INC2_CELL_B the same day. Determine the root cause for INC1_CELL_A.

INC1_CELL_A accessibility dropped to 63% on 2026-06-29. CM log shows ADMINISTRATIVESTATE changed to 0 on 2026-06-27. An alarm for eNB_INC3 was raised 2026-06-26 and cleared 2026-06-28. DL throughput also degraded. Identify the root cause and rule out interference.

On 2026-06-29, INC1_CELL_A KPIs degrade across accessibility, retainability, and throughput simultaneously. CM data shows three parameters changed on 2026-06-27. Determine the most impactful configuration change and whether further investigation is needed.

Starting 2026-06-29, INC1_CELL_A shows persistent accessibility degradation. Verify whether a power configuration change or a barring change is responsible by checking CM records for the 7 days before the incident.

INC2_CELL_B on eniq_oss_1 is completely down on 2026-06-29. Three alarms exist in history: 'Backhaul Link Down' (Critical, whole day), 'Scheduled Maintenance' (Info, 02:00-04:00), 'High Retainability Loss' (Major, 22:00-23:00). CM shows no changes. Identify root cause.

On 2026-06-29 INC2_CELL_B availability=0%. Alarm log: 'Power Failure' (Critical, 00:00-06:00 cleared), 'Backhaul Link Down' (Critical, 06:00-23:59). Traffic zero all day. Determine which failure caused the full-day outage and whether further investigation is needed.

INC2_CELL_B completely unavailable on 2026-06-29. An irrelevant 'Interference Detected' alarm for INC3_CELL_C2 was raised 2026-06-28 and is still active. No CM changes for INC2_CELL_B. Identify the outage cause using only relevant evidence.

INC2_CELL_B on eniq_oss_1 shows PMCELLDOWNTIMEAUTO=86400 on 2026-06-29. A CM change shows ADMINISTRATIVESTATE=0 set on 2026-06-20 (9 days prior, within normal range). Alarms include 'Backhaul Link Down' (Critical). Distinguish the outage cause from the old CM change.

INC3_CELL_C1 and INC3_CELL_C2 show ~54% DL throughput drop on 2026-06-29. INC3_CELL_C3 is also degraded. Retainability and accessibility are within normal range. No CM changes on eNB_INC3. An unrelated alarm 'Power Failure' for INC2_CELL_B exists. Determine the root cause.

INC3_CELL_C2 DL throughput degraded 54% on 2026-06-29. CM shows DLCHANNELBANDWIDTH changed for INC1_CELL_A (different eNB) on 2026-06-27. INC3 cells have no local CM changes. Retainability unchanged. Rule out the INC1_CELL_A bandwidth change as the cause.

INC3_CELL_C3 DL throughput dropped to 35kbps on 2026-06-29. Alarms: 'Scheduled Maintenance' (Info, eNB_INC3, 2026-06-28 cleared), 'Interference Detected' (Major, eNB_INC3, 2026-06-29 active). CM: no changes on eNB_INC3. Confirm whether alarm evidence corroborates interference root cause.

All three INC3 cells show simultaneous DL throughput degradation on 2026-06-29. INC1_CELL_A has CM changes. INC2_CELL_B is fully down. The agent must query all three INC3 cells individually and rule out local causes before concluding on the cluster-level root cause.

INC4_NR_D EN-DC setup success dropped to 55% on 2026-06-30. INC4_LTE_ANCHOR is healthy on all KPIs. An irrelevant 'Backhaul Link Down' alarm for INC2_CELL_B is still active. No CM changes for NR cell or LTE anchor. Isolate the NR root cause.

INC4_NR_D EN-DC rate at 55% on 2026-06-30. pmEndcSetupScgUeSucc also dropped. INC4_LTE_ANCHOR accessibility is 99.7% (healthy). CM: ADMINISTRATIVESTATE changed for INC4_LTE_ANCHOR on 2026-06-20 (old change within normal). Is the root cause NR-side or LTE anchor degradation?

INC4_NR_D EN-DC setup success rate 55% on 2026-06-30. EN-DC SCG setup also failed at same rate. INC4_LTE_ANCHOR healthy. Three alarms on eNB_INC4: 'NR Uplink Interference' (Major), 'Scheduled Maintenance' (Info, cleared), 'High CPU' (Minor). Identify which alarm is relevant.

NR INC4_NR_D EN-DC rate dropped 43.9pp on 2026-06-30. INC4_LTE_ANCHOR baseline is 99.8% accessibility. CM has EARFCNDL changed for INC1_CELL_A on 2026-06-27 and for INC4_LTE_ANCHOR on 2026-06-20. Alarm: 'NR Cell Degraded' Major on INC4_NR_D. Confirm root cause and whether INC4_LTE_ANCHOR EARFCN change is causal.

INC3_CELL_C2 on eniq_oss_1 shows a marginal DL throughput drop on 2026-06-25 (599M vs 600M PMPDCPVOLDLDRB — within 0.2% of baseline). No CM changes, no alarms. The NOC wants to know if this is actionable.

INC4_NR_D EN-DC rate on 2026-06-28 is 98% (normal). LTE anchor INC4_LTE_ANCHOR also normal. A CM change for EARFCNUL on INC4_LTE_ANCHOR is present from 2026-06-20 (8 days prior, not coinciding). No alarms. Determine if there is an active incident or if evidence is insufficient.

INC2_CELL_B fully down 2026-06-29. Alarm log returns an empty result (alarm retrieval tool error). KPI confirms PMCELLDOWNTIMEAUTO=86400. CM shows no changes. Agent cannot obtain alarm evidence. Determine root cause with incomplete data.

INC1_CELL_A accessibility dropped to 63% on 2026-06-29. CM shows CELLBARRED=1 set on 2026-06-27 but also a separate record showing CELLBARRED=0 restored on 2026-06-28. Alarm: 'Accessibility Degradation' (Major) raised on 2026-06-29 still active. Contradictory CM evidence — determine if root cause is still identifiable or if further investigation is required.
